forum.title: wireless dev board supporting LSM6DSV320X or other high-g accelerometer ?
forum.best_answer_content: Typical solution would be STM32WB5MMG host MCU, 16-128 MB QSPI flash for data logging, LSM6DSV320X, LIS2DU12 as watchdog accel, STBC08 battery charger and JST battery connector, USB-C and tag connect, rgb led, etc in a ~1 sq. inch 4-layer pcb. Idea is a small, wearable, ultra-low power device for data logging or streaming via BLE.
forum.content_text:
*Split from [Any accelerometer supporting >400g with integrated free-fall detection ?](https://community.st.com/t5/mems-sensors/any-accelerometer-supporting-gt-400g-with-integrated-free-fall/td-p/890720) - this is a separate question*

---

Hi Team,

Could you please suggest a suitable wireless development board that supports **LSM6DSV320X**, or any latest high g accelerometer sensors, apart from Sensor Tile Box Pro?

Idea is a small, wearable, ultra-low power device for data logging or streaming via BLE.
